title: Invariants for the empty circuit
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, the empty original gate list together with the empty new gate list, the identity vertex map, and count $n$ satisfies the fanout reduction invariants: the count is $n$; the new list is acyclic; the map is injective and sends each vertex below $n$ below $n$; computed values agree for every Boolean input; all fanouts are at most $2$ and mapped vertices have fanout zero; the gate conditions hold; and the new list has length at most zero.
